job_description_268257:
Responsibilities:

  • Propose solutions to solve complex system architecture challenges and actively lead the end-to-end development of the system.
  • Create robust, flexible, consistent, and easy-to-use APIs.
  • Continuously strive for performance improvements, code reusability, and readability.
  • Understand the product in detail and predict potential issues in feature development.
  • Mentor and lead junior members of the team.


Requirements:

  • Ability to think out of the box.
  • Tech or a higher degree in computer science or a related field.
  • 1+ years of experience working on back-end development for complex distributed systems who are willing to adopt any programming language as required.
  • Familiarity with any of the following - Java, C++, Scala, Kotlin, and frameworks like Spring, Play, Hibernate, Django, etc.
  • Good understanding of Algorithms, Data Structure, OOP, Design patterns, Parallel programming, Multithreading concepts, and Event-Driven Systems.
  • Understanding of micro-services architecture and best practices.
  • Experience with Relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or any NoSQL database.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS (Amazon Web Services), Azure, or Google Cloud.

job_description_326866:
Responsibilities:

  • Participate in design reviews and provide feedback on features and usability.
  • Translate use cases and/or technical specifications into test cases using programming language.
  • Identify test data requirements and generate required data to support testing Security/Vulnerability Testing.
  • Work on building a test automation framework by adding libraries.


Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in SDET/Development with at least 1+ years of experience in B2C application setup.
  • Ability to write functionally correct and readable automation code.
  • Possess good core testing skills which involve test case designing, test strategy, and test data creation.
  • Should possess sound debugging and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience in Appium or RESTful API automation with Java or other object-oriented languages.
  • Hands-on experience with testing tools like TestNG, Postman, Proxy tools, and Burp suite.
  • Knowledge of Maven, and Knowledge of docker, and AWS is an added advantage.
  • Programming Lang Java.
  • Good knowledge of Appium/ Selenium, and RestAssured frameworks.
  • Knowledge of SQL, No SQL.

job_description_235174:
Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for delivering the highest quality in a timely and cost-effective manner.
  • Responsible for estimating test efforts and communicating test results.
  • Responsible for enhancing and extending the automation library and framework.
  • Passionate for finding bottlenecks and thresholds in existing code through the use of automation tools.
  • Strong time management skills with a history of meeting commitments.
  • Understanding the requirements of concerned teams, preparing execution plans, devising automation strategy, and automation of test cases.
  • Strong understanding of test automation frameworks and architecture to provide automated solutions to complex problems.


Requirements:

  • Experience with developing and executing automation suites.
  • Experience with SQL, Tomcat, Linux, and Java.
  • Experience with scripting knowledge of Shellscript, and Groovy desired.
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills to root cause complex issues required.
  • Hands-on exposure in Selenium Webdriver / SOAP UI / QTP.
  • Working knowledge of one or more software programming languages like Java, C#, php, and Groovy.
  • Exposure to open source tools like Jenkins/ TestNG/ Appium/ API automation testing.
  • Good experience in shell scripting.
  • Proficiency in handling complex db queries.
  • Exposure to implementing CI.
  • Strong logical reasoning and problem-solving skills.
  • Should be good in communication and presentation skills.
  • Should be a self-starter with high initiative, a team player, and enthusiastic to learn and deliver on the latest tools and technologies.
  • 1-6 years of strong hands-on testing experience in web applications, desktop applications, and web services.

job_description_140884:
Responsibilities:

  • Build and deploy backend applications from scratch.
  • Interact with stakeholders to understand requirements, analyze the impact of changes, come up with reasonable timelines, and execute.
  • Plan and execute extensive load testing for services.
  • Create an execution plan for the team to iterate based on the load test findings to ensure a resilient, self-healing set of subsystems that have loose coupling and high cohesion.
  • Understand and analyze existing systems to identify improvements and performance/maintenance issues Fix or rebuild existing systems to ensure resilience.
  • Write extensive test cases in a way that systems can be easily modified in the future with confidence and without ambiguity.
  • Build ETL pipelines to collect data in a Data lake.
  • Use the Data lake to power BI and generate reports.
  • Maintain clear and concise documentation of technical specifications, code changes, and architectural decisions.


Requirements:

  • 3-8 years of hands-on experience in Backend technologies.
  • Experience in at least one of Java, DSA.
  • Experience with debugging and solving issues in a cloud environment.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL or similar databases.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases.
  • Deep understanding of technology and architecture in a highly scalable and available environment.
  • Experience with open-source technologies such as Elasticsearch, Redis, Kafka, etc, and their adoption into products.
  • Willingness to work in a startup-like environment.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science / Information Technology.
  • Prior experience in FinTech.
  • Experience in using AWS services such as S3 SNS, SQS, etc.
  • Contributed to open-source projects.
  • Experience with Big data pipelines.
  • Experience with BI tools.

job_description_317971:
Responsibilities:

  • Work as part of a team developing applications and services using Agile development methods.
  • Build microservices by writing reusable, testable, and efficient code.
  • Effectively use tools and ingenuity to identify and fix defects before they become a problem.
  • Develop and implement application architecture that is modular and scalable after understanding the business and design requirements.
  • Help come up with estimates for projects and individual tasks.
  • Help the team in solving technical challenges.
  • Have a good understanding of how applications will be deployed, managed, and operated in the production environment.
  • Make sure coding standards are followed through detailed code reviews.
  • Make sure that the code is well commented and documented along with any TODOs on technical debt and shortcuts that need to be addressed later.


Requirements:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in software development with in-depth knowledge of Golang, Java, or any other language that supports multithreading.
  • Excellent knowledge of MongoDB.
  • Ability to create database schemas that represent and support business processes.
  • Strong analytical skills and problem-solving aptitude.
  • Ability to take project and product ownership for successful delivery within the decided budgets and timelines.
  • Should understand fundamental design patterns and principles behind a scalable and secure application.
  • Should have strong communication, decision-making, and leadership skills.
  • Knowledge of frontend technologies like React and Redux will be an added plus.
  • Experience with user authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments will be an added plus.
  • Experience with automated testing platforms and unit tests will be an added plus.
  • Prior experience in a fast-moving startup environment would be great.
